segments.name: hook
segments.say: You're about to yawn. And you can't stop it.

segments.name: copy
segments.say: When you see someone yawn, your brain copies it. Automatically.

segments.name: resist
segments.say: Scientists tested it. Trying not to yawn only makes the urge stronger.

segments.name: kids
segments.say: Little kids don't catch yawns at all. It only starts around age four or five.

segments.name: dog
segments.say: Even dogs catch yawns from humans. Especially from their owners.

segments.name: chain
segments.say: And it spreads faster between friends and family than between strangers.

segments.name: why
segments.say: But why does it happen? Scientists still don't fully agree.

segments.name: payoff
segments.say: Even reading about it works. So, did you just yawn?
